header.name: PatrixWorld Sampler [DRIPBARK v0.2.5]
header.description: v0.2.5 DRIPBARK — grass_side dirt variance + dripstone + bark variance. (1) grass_block_side: 16 composite variants, keeping the original Patrix grass+transition strip on top (user confirmed grass_top variation works and asked for it left alone) while swapping the dirt portion (rows 20-63) for 16 different Patrix dirt CTM tiles. Registered under grass_block_side + legacy grass_side alias. (2) dripstone_block: 8 synthesized variants via rotation/flip/wrap-shift (Patrix ships only 1 dripstone_block.png — no CTM library for it). (3) pointed_dripstone: 8 shape textures (base/middle/frustum/tip × up/down) generated fresh using Patrix dripstone color data with tapered silhouette masks approximating vanilla proportions. Replaces vanilla low-res stalactite/stalagmite textures. (4) Bark variance: 8 variants per species × 10 species × 2 faces (side + end grain) = 160 new bark variant PNGs. Registered as variations arrays on all 10 log/stem shortnames. Synthesized via rotation/flip (Patrix has only single log textures, no bark CTM). Total 247 new PNGs. Carries v0.2.4 DENSE+VARS + v0.2.3 BARKFIX.
